title: Cooper DeJean and the Eagles' Defense Underperforming
subtitle: The player is not meeting expectations this season
excerpt: Cooper DeJean, who joined the team as one of the top corners of 2024, has played below expectations for the Eagles' defense, raising doubts about his role.
author: Daniele Morais
sourceName: Inquirer.com, NBC Sports Philadelphia, NFL Rumors - ProFootballRumors.com
contentHtml:
Cooper DeJean's name has once again come into the spotlight after the Eagles revealed that the player, who arrived as one of the best corners of 2024, has been underperforming on defense. The news follows reports that DeJean has struggled to maintain the performance level that positioned him among the league's elite.

Cooper DeJean: From Stardom to Underperformance

DeJean was ranked No. 1 by Pro Football Focus (PFF) among all corners in his 2024 rookie season and held the No. 2 spot among nickel corners in the previous season. However, since the player began partially playing the safety position this season, his performance has declined, becoming a concern for coach Vic Fangio.

Impact on Defensive Statistics

In just two games this current season, the Eagles' defense has not forced any turnovers and has recorded only one sack. DeJean, along with Jalen Carter and Quinyon Mitchell, continues to fall short of his elite standard. PFF statistics show that DeJean has yet to record an interception in 34 regular-season games.

On-Field Positioning Decisions

Fangio stated that, despite the difficulties, he does not intend to move DeJean to full-time safety. The current strategy continues to involve the player rotating between the safety and nickel corner positions, which may be contributing to his lack of consistency.

Outlook for the Rest of the Season

The coach also mentioned the possibility of more playing time for Jalen Carter, who recently signed a $152 million contract. Carter, who is recovering from wrist injuries, may get more opportunities if the defense continues to struggle to establish itself as a cohesive unit.

Team and Fan Reaction

Although specific reaction details are not available in the sources, DeJean's situation has sparked discussions about the effectiveness of the Eagles' defense and the need for tactical adjustments to ensure the team remains competitive this season.
